1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and __control means arranged to modulate the first and second valves to achieve anti-lock braking control by dynamically adjusting air pressure in the brake chamber based on real-time feedback from vehicle sensors__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __plural first valves and plural second valves arranged in a modular configuration__.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves comprise __at least one larger valve arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and at least one smaller valve arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, wherein the larger and smaller valves are independently controlled__.

4. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the __at least one smaller valve is arranged to operate at high speed with response times of less than 100 milliseconds__.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein __the control means comprises binary actuators that operate in discrete on-off states to control the first and second valves__.

6. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive __real-time control signals from both a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for continuously determining the pressure in the brake chamber and adjusting valve operation accordingly__.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive __continuous data from a vehicle speed sensor and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds, and to dynamically control braking force based thereon to prevent wheel lock-up__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors and stored reference data, __an optimum speed for each wheel independently and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed to maintain traction during braking events__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising __one or more air braking units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; a central compressed air storage tank; and a control module in communication with wheel speed sensors and air pressure sensors on each wheel brake unit__.
